init_linear_layer: create a python module that initializes weight and bias parameters for a JAX linear layer with given input and output dimensions
linear_layer: build a python script that evaluates a linear layer by computing the dot product of inputs and weights plus an optional bias
split_into_blocks: create a function that splits a square JAX array into sub-blocks along the leading two axes using specified block dimensions
slogdet: build a python module that computes the sign and natural logarithm of the determinant of a square matrix with a fast path for 1x1 matrices
logdet_matmul: create a function that combines FermiNet orbital determinants with optional weights in the log domain using the log-sum-exp trick
